take: According to the Blues' announcement, St. Louis reinstated D Logan Mailloux from injured reserve, recalled D Calle Rosen from Springfield (AHL), and assigned Ds Theo Lindstein and Adam Jiříček to Springfield. Jiříček, a second-pair defenseman at 15.85 minutes a night, has been a plus for the team: STL controls 52% of the 5-on-5 expected goals (a measure of chance quality) with him on the ice, 4.5 points better than without him. Lindstein's six games went the other way, at 45% with the team 4.6 points worse. Going by how the coach has used his defense, Justin Barron is next in line for Jiříček's minutes.
